title: Actuarial Share Table: Partial-Year Dividend at a Whole Life Insurance Reduced Paid-Up Election
content:
At a reduced paid-up election on an Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy, a dividend for the part of the policy year elapsed at the election is added to the net cash value, as a share of the most recent declared dividend on the policy ledger.

## Share by whole months elapsed

The share is fixed by the whole months from the most recent anniversary to the date the election takes effect:

| Whole months elapsed | Share of the most recent declared dividend |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 50% (0.5) |
| 1 to 5 | Those months over 12 |
| Fewer than 1 | Nothing |

The partial-year dividend is rounded half up to the cent.

| Months | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 7 to 11 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Share | 0 | 1 over 12 | 2 over 12 | 3 over 12 | 4 over 12 | 5 over 12 | 0.5 | 0.5 |

The most recent anniversary is the anniversary the posted cash values are as of; the effective date is the paid-to date; a whole month is counted each time the same day of the month as the anniversary is reached.

## Worked cases (hypothetical latest declared dividend 1240.00, anniversary March 1)

- Effective July 1: 4 whole months, 1240.00 times 4 over 12, that is 413.33.
- Effective September 1: 6 whole months, 620.00.
- Effective March 20: fewer than 1 month, nothing.
